fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that rural primary schools in Mali predominantly record attendance, enrolment and grades on paper, citing a 2024 study of Malian basic-education schools that found 90% of administrative tasks manual (enrolment in paper registers or Excel, learner files as physical dossiers), and that it found no evidence of digital recording at school level.
